n01.heard: In my town, everyone is born with a number of hugs.

n04.heard: Zero means you can't give one, not even to your mom.

n05.heard: So every morning, she messes up my hair instead.

n07.heard: He'd been saving it for 10 years.

n08.heard: Everyone said he was just cold

n09.heard: Then, one winter night, Grandpa got sick.

n10.heard: That's when I learned the rule nobody tells you.

n11.heard: You can't use your last hug.

n12.heard: You can only give it away.

n13.heard: Grandpa saved his last hug for 10 years!

n14.heard: I only saved mine for 10 seconds.
